facts.value: void hsd_803B2B20(u8* src, int len, void* dest). The source pointer is not const-qualified in the declaration, though its bytes are only read. len is signed; positive values consume that many bytes and nonpositive values consume none. dest must provide at least 16 writable bytes for the fixed output.
facts.rationale: Use the authoritative canonical declaration rather than an effective const-qualified signature under an inferred name.

facts.value: u8* src supplies bytes read for indices 0 through len-1 when len is positive. All source consumption precedes the final destination copy; source storage is preserved only where it does not overlap destination storage.
facts.rationale: Qualify preservation for permitted source/destination overlap; canonical reads precede all output writes.

facts.value: int len controls the byte-consumption loop; zero and negative values skip all source reads.
facts.rationale: Role follows canonical formal parameter use; no physical ABI register claim is made.

facts.value: void* dest receives exactly 16 bytes after all source consumption and correction; valid writable output storage is required.
facts.rationale: Role follows canonical formal parameter use; no physical ABI register claim is made.

facts.value: Uses a fresh 16-byte local seed on every call and accumulates source bytes modulo 256 into lanes i % 16. It then scans left to right, inverting a byte equal to the previously finalized byte, so adjacent output bytes differ. For len <= 0 the seed is returned unchanged. All input reads precede the 16-byte destination copy; no source or destination bounds checks, allocation, persistent state or I/O occur in this routine.
facts.rationale: Record loop order, nonpositive-length behavior and source-before-output mutation boundaries.
